references.label: Ordered drop-target bank
references.description: One of the banks whose lit sequence qualifies the captive-ball lock and advances Bonus X.

references.label: Captive-ball hole
references.description: Hole lit by an ordered bank completion; locks the first ball for two-ball play.

references.label: Release Captive Ball lane
references.description: Lane that releases the locked ball and begins two-ball play.

references.label: Top-center Special lane
references.description: Lane that collects Special after all target banks are completed in order.

references.label: Extra Ball spot target
references.description: Target that collects Extra Ball after all top lanes and one ordered bank are complete.
